$comment: The source of sf-input's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/input (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how. The folder was `inputs`; it takes the tag's name (§3, §21, §16 item 16).

size.summary: The step of the control ladder the field stands on, the height of sf-button and sf-button-icon of the same size. sf-input and every field of the family (lookup, quantity, date, code, colour, phone, textarea, rich text, dropdown, file upload, image) stand on all five steps.

radius.summary: The field's corners, as sf-button's radius names them: empty and default are the controls' rounded square, square has none, rounded is a pill (a search field beside rounded buttons). --sf-input-radius still wins.

appearance.summary: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or hidden.

label.summary: The visible label above the field, in the text ink a step below the value (14 beside a 16 value, 14 on a phone too; C153 (1)); it names the native control. Without it, give aria-label.

required.summary: The field must hold a value: the label gets the required mark, «*» in the label's ink (C153 (2); the form says once what it means, «* — обязательные поля»), and the native control the required constraint.

placeholder.summary: Example text shown in the empty field in the quiet ink; it disappears with the first character and is not a label.

input-type.summary: The kind of text the field takes, the native input type: text, email, password, search, tel, url or number (with min, max and step). A number field draws no browser arrows and digits of one width (C153 (7)); exact numbers with a unit or steps belong to sf-input-quantity (steppers="none").

autocomplete.summary: The autofill hint the browser reads, as the native autocomplete (email, tel, current-password, off). Empty: not written.

inputmode.summary: Which on-screen keyboard a phone opens, as the native inputmode (numeric, decimal, tel, email, url, search). Empty: the keyboard of the type.

minlength.summary: The fewest characters the value may have, as the native minlength; a shorter value is invalid (too short). Empty: no limit.

maxlength.summary: The most characters the value should have (C153 (10), C141 (1)). The count shows from 80 % of it at the end of the message line; past it the count and the frame turn to the error colour and the field is invalid (too-long), so the form is not sent. The text is never cut, as the native maxlength would; a masked field keeps the native limit. Empty: no limit, no count.

counter.summary: With maxlength: the count shows always, not only from 80 % of the limit (C153 (10), C141 (1)).

pattern.summary: A regular expression the whole value must match, as the native pattern; a value that does not match is invalid (pattern mismatch).

min.summary: The smallest number a number field (input-type number) takes, as the native input's min; below it the field is invalid (range underflow). Not written on other types.

max.summary: The largest number a number field takes, as the native input's max; above it the field is invalid (range overflow). Not written on other types.

step.summary: The step of a number field, as the native input's step: 1 when empty, any for any number; a value off the step is invalid (step mismatch). Not written on other types.

hint.summary: The help line under the field; on an error the error message takes its place.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» (sf-help-mark, C133's look) after the label text (C153 (8)): a step below the value as the label, --sf-space-1/4 after its last word; the label row keeps its height. The mark is named by its subject («Подробнее: <label>»). Empty: no mark.

default-value.summary: The value the field starts with and returns to on a form reset, without controlling it afterwards. Empty: value is used.

name.summary: The name the value is sent under in a form, as the native name.

icon-start.summary: The name of an icon drawn at the start of the field, before the value (a search glass, an envelope). Empty: no icon.

text-start.summary: A short text drawn at the start of the field, before the value, the twin of text-end (C153 (9)): «https://», «@», «+7». In the hint's ink, on the C77 inset, not part of the value; the native control is described by it. Empty: no text.

text-end.summary: A short text drawn at the end of the field, after the value: a unit or a currency (kg, ₽, %). Empty: no text.

shortcut.summary: A key combination drawn at the end of the field as the kbd component's soft caps in the muted ink (owner decisions C04, C38): words joined by +, e.g. mod+k (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere), shift+mod+p, / or escape; mod is Cmd on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The keys take the text step one below the value's (size 1 a plate of 20 with letters of 14). Written as aria-keyshortcuts on the native input. A hint only: the field does not listen to it. Empty: no keys

hint-icon.summary: The name of an icon drawn at the end of the field as a hint (info, help). Empty: no icon.

disabled.summary: The field takes no input, no focus and is not sent with the form; it draws the disabled look.

readonly.summary: The value can be read, selected and copied but not changed; it is sent with the form. The field draws the region line instead of the control border.

clearable.summary: A clear glyph (×) at the field's end while the field holds a value (C123), named «Очистить»: a press empties the field, says so with input and change and gives the focus back to it. It is no Tab stop (C153 (6)): Escape in the field empties it instead, and an empty field lets Escape go on. A search field (input-type search) has both without the setting, in place of the browser's own.

invalid.summary: Marks the value as wrong from the page: the error border, aria-invalid on the native control and error-message under the field. Without it the field shows its own errors (C153 (3)): after a failed submit on every wrong field (the first takes the focus), then on leaving a field the person changed, gone the moment the value is right, in the component's words; never the browser's bubble.

error-message.summary: The text shown under the field while it is invalid, in the error colour, in place of the hint; it is the control's error message for assistive technology.

mask.summary: Turns on the input mask: typing is held to mask-pattern (or mask-options) and the fixed characters are drawn by the mask.

mask-pattern.summary: The mask with mask on: 0 a digit, a a letter, * any character, {...} a fixed part kept in the value, [ ] an optional tail, \ escapes the next character; any other character is shown only. Example: +{7} (000) 000-00-00.

mask-lazy.summary: With mask: true (or empty) shows the fixed characters only as they are reached, false shows the whole mask with placeholder characters from the start.

mask-placeholder-char.summary: With mask and mask-lazy false: the character that stands for a position still to be typed. Empty: the mask's own, _.

mask-options.summary: The full mask configuration as JSON, for what mask-pattern cannot say; it wins over mask-pattern. Invalid JSON is ignored.

value.summary: The current value. Written by the page, it controls the field; the value property reads what is typed.

change.summary: The value was committed; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

input.summary: The value changed while typing; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.summary: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.summary: The field's own value before the reset.

inherited-value.summary: The inherited value it returns to.

name.summary: The form name, empty when the field has none.

relations.name: icon-buttons
$comment: The reset back to an inherited value is an icon button (simai/ui-source#28).

relations.name: kbd
$comment: The keys of a shortcut are the kbd component's (soft caps inside a field):
fetched with the field, so the first paint draws them as they stay.

relations.name: cl-help-mark
$comment: The «?» after the label (help, owner decision C153 (8)) is sf-help-mark: fetched with the field.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-input for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
error is a dated alias of invalid; the shim maps the attribute and the property

rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: the legacy name of icon-start; icon-start wins when both are given
the legacy name of text-end; text-end wins when both are given

the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
rows.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

x-summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: folder and id: inputs -> input (§3, §21). The loader bundle is cl-input; the former bundle name cl-inputs is a dated Loader forward to it (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json, until 2026-12-01), not a rule of its own, so the registry counts one Smart component. The registry id follows the folder and the tag: smart.input; smart.inputs is its dated alias in the change journal (path-smart-inputs-to-input, until 2026-12-01).

trait-words: the field-inherit@1 words stay in lang x-trait-words beside the component words, as the sf-switch pilot keeps them; the running words are helpers/inherited-value.js INHERITED_TEXT until the trait has its own folder (Annex A item 13 is open).

trait field-inherit@1: host state data-inherited (§5.3, §20.2) and the trait event sf-field-reset with sf-field:reset as its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json), as the sf-switch pilot; an inherited value never satisfies required (§20.2).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the required e-mail reference) plus the three appearances, icon-start/text-end, invalid with a message, disabled, read-only, inherited and size 2.
css-variables: the six public variables of public-variables.v1.json plus --sf-input-invalid-border-color for the invalid state (§6).
error -> invalid (§17.2), type -> appearance, left-icon -> icon-start, right-text -> text-end: dated setting aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); the canonical name wins.
form.validity: what the native input reports and the host mirrors -- value-missing, type-mismatch, pattern-mismatch, too-short, too-long -- and custom-error (§17.2).
form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals; the native input (the hidden one too) carries no name (§17.1 item 6); read-only still submits.
minlength and maxlength stay strings as converted (no x-todo raised them; a type change is a major).
version 1.3.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10).

version 1.3.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.3.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.3.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.4.0: the trait event is declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset (standard 1.3.13 §8: an event a trait brings is named sf-<verb>, with no tag): the element sends sf-field-reset itself and the manifest describes it, with tag in the detail. Before, the registry described only the retired sf-field:reset and no current name, and the new name came from the alias shim alone. The dated sf-field:reset follows with the same detail and one cancel until 2026-12-01.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (§4.10): input-type takes number and the settings min, max and step are added (Larena after sf-wizard, msg-12cd5ef6). A number field is the browser's own: min, max and step go to the native input as given (only on a number field), its validation is the field's -- range underflow, range overflow and step mismatch make the field and its form invalid, as required does -- and inputmode (numeric, decimal) picks the phone keyboard. The value stays a string, the text the native input holds, and the form submits it under name. A stepper with buttons stays sf-input-quantity.

version 1.5.1: with a hint or an error and an inherited value, the inherited sentence is also a hidden note that aria-describedby names after the message, because a browser reads aria-describedby instead of aria-description and the sentence went unsaid (helpers/inherited-value.js, syncInheritedNote). Nothing is drawn differently.

version 1.6.1 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. A shared sheet it draws with moved in the next block (src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.css, the C27 inherited-value reset), so the component takes a patch with it.

version 1.6.0: size takes 1/3 and 3 again for sf-input alone, on the control ladder (--sf-ui-<size>--control-height): .sf-input drew no height at those steps and fell to its 20px line; radius ("", default, square, rounded) draws the field as sf-button's radius does, rounded a pill. Actions block, item 4 (docs review 2026-11-08).

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (§4.10): the setting shortcut (owner decision C38; C04 names the field beside the button). It draws the combination at the end of the field, after text-end, as the kbd component's keys -- holding with a per key (sf-kbd--square on a one-character key; off an Apple platform a + between words) -- in the muted ink, and as aria-keyshortcuts on the native input. The keys take the text step one below the value's, read by the kbd sheet from the field's size class (component.kbd 1.3.0: 1/3 and 1/2 a plate of 16, 1 20, 2 24, 3 28), and the field's end is a centred flex row (component.inputs 1.3.0), so a key sits on the field's middle (it sat 1-2 px low). The field does not listen to the combination. kbd is a relation.

version 1.7.1 (2026-11-10): a patch (FA-06, DEV precheck forms A). Every setting has its words: the 24 settings and the value that had none (label, required, placeholder, input-type, autocomplete, inputmode, minlength, maxlength, pattern, hint, default-value, name, icon-start, text-end, hint-icon, disabled, readonly, invalid, error-message, mask, mask-pattern, mask-lazy, mask-placeholder-char, mask-options, value) say what they do in the reference. The class sheet it draws with (component.inputs 1.3.1, FA-08) keeps a filled field's placeholder on the quiet ink, on-surface-variant, as the bordered field's; only the value is on-surface.

version 1.7.2 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-on-disable → --sf-on-surface-disabled. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-11): a minor (C55 acceptance F1: one form reads as one). A required field left empty shows its required error once the form's check fails -- the host's invalid event on a submit attempt, checkValidity() or reportValidity() -- as sf-dropdown 1.9.0 does: the error border (filled: the error fill), «Заполните поле» (lang runtime value-missing; en «Fill in this field») under the field in the field-message type, aria-invalid and aria-errormessage on the control; the person's input that fills it, or form.reset(), clears it. Before, only the browser's bubble said it. The bubble and the browser's focus on the first invalid field are unchanged; the page's invalid and error-message win over it (helpers/form-field.js ShownRequired). R2 (DEV acceptance 2026-11-11, D1): the shown required error goes whenever the value stops being missing, whatever set it -- the person's input or change, a value set from script, a value attribute -- as sf-dropdown 1.9.0 (ShownRequired clears in the form sync every one of them ends in, not on input/change only).

version 1.8.1 (2026-11-13, R214 FA-7): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The input-type summary no longer promises a reveal button for password: the field never drew one (a password field is the browser's own). The reveal button waits for the owner's answer on the look of icon actions inside fields (R214 #q-look, #q-eye: research ui-control control/research/2026-11-13-field-icon-actions.md); the summary says it again when it is built. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.9.0 (2026-11-13, owner decision C123; R214, research ui-control control/research/2026-11-13-field-icon-actions.md, prototype prototypes/field-icon-actions.html): a minor (§4.10), a look and two actions. (1) The actions inside the field are the field layer's .sf-field-action (component.inputs 1.6.0, scss/_field-action.scss): a glyph without a plate in any state, on-surface-variant at rest and on-surface under the pointer and on a press, the keyboard ring round the glyph inside the field; the glyph is the leading icon's size (--sf-text-height-<size>: 24 / 20 / 28 at 1, 1/2, 2 on a desktop), its end on the plain inset (C77), its invisible hit area the field's inner height and the glyph plus half the inset wide, never under 24. (2) The setting clearable (boolean): a clear (close glyph, «Очистить» / «Clear», lang runtime clear) while the field holds a value and can be changed; a press empties it with input and change from the native input and gives the focus back to it. A search field (input-type search) has the clear without the setting, and the browser's own cancel glyph is hidden. (3) A password field draws the reveal (C123 (5)): a toggle button «Показать пароль» / «Show password» (lang runtime reveal) with aria-pressed, the eye (visibility) at rest and the crossed eye (visibility_off) while the password shows as text; a form reset hides it again. Order from the text to the edge (C123 (6)): text-end, clear, reveal, then the shortcut keys and the hint icon; with an end slot the actions stand before the slot's content. Both are Tab stops. Values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.9.1 (2026-11-14, fields ladder; R222 groundwork): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The size setting's summary names the field ladder every field now shares (component/field-size.js FIELD_LADDER): sf-input-lookup, -quantity, -date, -code, -color and -country take the same five steps at the same heights. A class-markup label row (.sf-input-label without the flex class) is its label line with or without the help mark (component.inputs 1.6.1); the element's own row was already. Text inputs study (2026-11-14, control/research/2026-11-14-text-inputs.md; fixes under existing decisions): (TI-2, C77) the value starts 12 from the outer edge at 1/3 and 24 at 3, the 1 px border counted inside, as at 1/2, 1 and 2 -- the outer steps stood at their padding plus the border plus the text step (19 and 37 on a desktop, 16 and 33 on a phone); compact 1/3 is 12 and 3 is 20; (TI-3, C77 «телефон 12») on a phone every step starts the value 12 from the edge -- size 2 stood at 16, size 3 at 33 (component.inputs 1.6.1, field-ladder.inset); the end actions (clear, reveal) stand on the same inset; (TI-24) words written into the label slot stand in .sf-input-text, so a custom label keeps the label's step, line and ink (it drew 16 on 24 in the text ink, its row 4 taller at size 1); a help mark written beside them stays in the label row. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.10.1 (2026-11-14, group build 5; numbered above 1.10.0 on origin/fix/form-fields-fm): a patch, its own code unchanged: the passport family is the first word of the tag (C174, NM-5; fix/sets-step-1); 2 first-paint snapshot file(s) follow the merged markup (fix/icons-c151).

version 1.11.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C153; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-text-inputs.md, prototype prototypes/text-inputs-study.html; written on the branch as 1.10.0): a minor. (1) The label is in the text ink, a step below the value; at size 1 it is 14 on a phone too (it was 12 beside a 16 value); the hint keeps the hint ink. (2) The required «*» is in the label's ink (it was the error colour) and hidden from assistive technology, which hears the native required. (3) The field shows its own errors (helpers/form-field.js ShownValidity, the whole family): a failed check of the form shows every wrong field at once and the first takes the focus when the person submitted; afterwards, and once the person has changed the value, leaving the field checks it; a shown error goes the moment the value is right; the words are the component's, in the page's language (lang runtime value-missing, type-mismatch(-email, -url), pattern-mismatch, too-short, too-long, range-underflow, range-overflow, step-mismatch, bad-input); the browser's bubble is cancelled on the host and on the native input. (4) Hover draws the border in the text ink; focus by mouse or keys draws a 2 px primary edge inside the field (an outline of --sf-focus--width at minus its width), no outer ring, no shift (R242: an outer ring was cut by scrolling containers). (5) A field the browser filled (:autofill) is tinted whole in the primary select state (--sf-primary-state-select), the text in the text ink, both themes. (6) The clear glyph is no Tab stop; Escape empties a clearable or search field that holds a value; the password reveal stays a Tab stop. (7) A number field draws no browser arrows and tabular digits. (8) New setting help: an sf-help-mark after the label, named «Подробнее: <label>» (lang runtime help). (9) New setting text-start, the twin of text-end. (10) New setting counter; maxlength is counted by C141 (1) (helpers/char-count.js, lang runtime count-text and too-long), the text is not cut, past the limit the field is invalid (too-long).

version 1.12.0 (2026-11-15, owner decision C191 (1)-(3); research ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-recipe-parts.md, prototype prototypes/recipe-parts-study.html; written on the branch as 1.11.0): a minor (§4.10), the password reveal finished. Numbered above 1.10.0 (C153 and the branches that carry it); nothing here depends on them. (1) #q-pw-hide: a revealed password hides again when its form is sent -- the submit button, Enter in a field, requestSubmit() -- as on form.reset(): the native input is type password before the submit event reaches the page (a document capture listener; the form owner is the host's form, the form attribute counts), so a page that stops the event and sends the form itself, and a password manager reading the field, both see dots; aria-pressed false, the eye back. Another form's submit leaves it shown. (2) #q-pw-hit: on a touch screen (@media (pointer: coarse)) the eye's invisible hit area is a square of the field's inner height (--sf-field-action--hit-block: control height less the two border pixels, never under 24): 26x26 / 34x34 / 42x42 / 50x50 at 1/2, 1, 2, 3 on a phone, it was 24x26 / 26x34 / 30x42 / 30x50. The glyph keeps its size and still ends on the inset (the field layer's end margin follows the hit width); a clear beside it stands that much further from the eye. A fine pointer keeps the C123 (3) width. (3) #q-pw-caps: while the password field has the focus and Caps Lock is on (getModifierState('CapsLock') on every key down and up and on a click in the field; a Tab into the field counts), a line «Включён Caps Lock» / «Caps Lock is on» (lang runtime caps-lock) stands under the field where the hint stands, in the hint's type and quiet ink (also under an error, below the error line); a visually hidden role=status aria-live=polite line after the label says it once (the shown line is aria-hidden). Leaving the field or turning Caps Lock off takes it away. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.0 (2026-11-15, owner decision C123 (1), (2), (6); R214; one number above the unreleased 1.11.0 of fix/password-c191; written on the branch as 1.12.0): a minor, a look. The reset to the inherited value (the shared inherited-value slot, src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.js) is the field layer's action (component.inputs, .sf-field-action, the glyph sf-input's clear and reveal draw) in place of a link icon button of the step below: no plate in any state, on-surface-variant at rest and on-surface under the pointer and on a press, the keyboard ring round the glyph; the glyph is the field's text line (the leading icon's size: 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 36 at sizes 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3 on a desktop; it was the step-below button's 16-24 glyph in a 28-40 button); the hit area is invisible and never under 24. In the field box the hit area is the field's inner height; the value keeps half the field's inset to the glyph (also at 1/3, where the 24 floor widens the hit area), a clear or reveal after it stands half an inset on, and the last glyph ends on the field's inset (C123 (6)). Its name is unchanged: «Сбросить к наследуемому» / «Reset to inherited» (reset-label), aria-label and title; Tab reaches it after the value. The «наследуется» marker is unchanged. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.1 (2026-11-15, register RG-S2-15, owner decisions C12 (3) and C123 (4); numbered above 1.13.0 of group build 7): a patch, the reveal's name. The password reveal is named by what a press does next: «Показать пароль» / «Show password» while the password is hidden, «Скрыть пароль» / «Hide password» (lang runtime conceal, new) while it shows; it carries no aria-pressed (a name that changes takes none, C12 (3)), as the field-renderers' password eye did before TI-7 made it this one. Before, it kept «Показать пароль» with aria-pressed="true" after a press. Look, glyphs, settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.2 (written on the branch as 1.13.1; 2026-11-15, owner decision C201; numbered above group build 7's 1.13.0): a patch, its own code unchanged. The actions inside the field (the clear, the password reveal) take the primary colour on a press, as the icon button's plain look does (component.inputs 1.8.0, the shared .sf-field-action rule); at rest and under the pointer, the geometry and the ring round the glyph are C123's, unchanged. The docs say so.

version 1.14.0 (2026-11-16, owner decision C151 (1), follow-up of fix/fields-in1 RG-IN-3; above 1.13.1 of fix/small-defects-rg-s2, the highest on any branch): a look. The template sheet's own size 3 icon rule (the start and hint icons at the text line, 24 on a phone) is gone, so the class layer's field-ladder.icon draws them: 36, and 28 on a phone. version 1.14.1 (2026-11-16, owner decision C141 (1), GB4 acceptance follow-up (1); numbered above 1.14.0 on origin/fix/field-ladder-icons): a patch. The count of a field with maxlength shows from 80 % of the limit, as the decision and these docs say: at 80 characters of 100 (0.8 x limit and more), where it showed only from the 81st (more than 0.8 x limit). The shared rule is src/smart/helpers/char-count.js. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

The size setting's summary names every field of the family on the field ladder: sf-dropdown 1.18.0, sf-file-upload 1.5.0 and sf-input-image 1.9.0 joined the textarea and the rich text, which already stood on it. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.15.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.15.0 on origin/fix/layer-order-c273): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.15.2 (written on the branch as 1.15.0; 2026-11-17): a minor (owner decision C273, utility or component). The component's fill, edge colour, text colour and the place roles it declares stand in the new cascade layer sf.paint, under the utilities, so a bg-*, border-* or color-* class on it or on one of its parts now paints it; its size, padding, radius, height and edge width stay in sf.components, over the utilities. The look without a utility is unchanged (the built sheets hold the same declarations, the paint ones in sf.paint). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input for a single-line text, email, password, search, telephone or URL value that must participate in a native form.
do_not: Do not use Input for multiline text, numeric steppers, selects or date selection
Do not use the hidden presentation for visible interactive controls
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input, or null before render.

onInput.summary: Adds a listener for input on the host. Returns the element.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for change on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyUp.summary: Adds a listener for keyup on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyDown.summary: Adds a listener for keydown on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a field rendered without a visible label; it lands on the native input.

inherited-value.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no value of its own -- a default from a parent setting, a brand, a theme. Shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a value of its own, a reset button returns it here. A number field is sf-input with inputmode numeric or decimal and takes it the same way.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).
